name: mapapps-geoprocessing
description: This bundle enables the execution of Geoprocessing services.

name: mapapps-layer-sorting
description: The Layer Sorting Bundle allows filtering and reorganizing domain bundle contents on a per app base.

name: mapapps-attribute-slider
description: The Attribute Slider provides an interactive slider widget for filtering map layers based on attribute values.

name: mapapps-simple-sketching
description: The Simple Sketching Bundle integrates the default ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript Sketching into map.apps.

name: mapapps-portal-item-loader
description: This bundle provides access to portal content.

name: mapapps-bookmarks
description: The bookmarks bundle allows to store the extent of the map as several bookmarks.

name: mapapps-query-builder
description: The Query Builder Bundle allows you to create your own Query Tools, that perform custom queries to a store.

name: mapapps-selection-actions
description: This bundle provides additional selection input actions for map.apps selection-services bundle.

name: mapapps-time-slider
description: The Time Slider bundle allows the user to change the time extent for FeatureLayers.

name: mapapps-devnet-blueprint
description: Developer template project for Developer Network Bundles.

name: mapapps-printing-enhanced
description: This bundle extends the printing bundle. It adds a preview of the print area and allows to configure several printing options.

name: mapapps-related-tables
description: The Related Tables bundle extends popups to display data from related tables.

name: mapapps-editing-reshape-interceptor
description: The Editing Reshape Interceptor bundle prevents that polygons and geometries can be moved while editing.

name: mapapps-basemap-slider
description: The Basemap Slider Bundle provides a widget that allows you to fade between different basemaps.

name: mapapps-fontawesome
description: This bundle allows you to use font awesome icons as themes extension in map.apps.

name: mapapps-gis-icons
description: mapapps-gis-icons allows you to use the Font-GIS icons as map.apps bundle.

name: mapapps-imprint-privacy
description: This bundle adds two buttons to the app, which refer to the imprint and the privacy statements.

name: mapapps-what3words
description: This bundle integrates what3words into map.apps.

name: mapapps-welcome
description: The Welcome Bundle is a widget for displaying a welcome screen with a Do-Not-Show-Again checkbox.

name: mapapps-toc-description-html
description: This bundle provides an additional toc action for map.apps toc bundle that allows you to use html in layer descriptions.

name: mapapps-toc-action-renderer
description: This bundle adds another action to the TOC which allows to customize the renderer of a layer.

name: mapapps-toc-action-datatable
description: This bundle provides an additional toc action that opens the map.apps resultcenter and shows all features of a layer in tabular form.

name: mapapps-streetsmart
description: This bundle makes it possible to use the Street Smart product within a map.apps app.

name: mapapps-slice
description: This bundle lets the user slice through 3D layers.It integrates the Esri slice Widget into mapapps.

name: mapapps-sketching-enhanced
description: This bundle adds an extended sketching functionality the map.

name: mapapps-search-layers
description: This bundle adds a new search store that allows the user to search for layers.

name: mapapps-screenshot
description: This bundle provides two tools to take simple or configured screenshots of the map.

name: mapapps-popups-types
description: The Popups Types bundle allows to configure popup templates in a central place and to reuse them more often.

name: mapapps-popups-draggable
description: This bundle makes popups draggable to move them to other positions on the screen.

name: mapapps-popups-action-maximize
description: This bundle adds a new action to maximize a popup.

name: mapapps-overviewmap
description: The Overview Map gives better orientation to the user by showing the current extent of the map in a smaller scaled map within a separated window.

name: mapapps-map-controls
description: The MapControls bundle allows you to easily navigate your map.

name: mapapps-locationfinder
description: This bundle provides an omnisearch store for connecting to the Esri CH LocationFinder service.

name: mapapps-lineofsight
description: The LineOfSight widget is a 3D analysis tool that allows you to perform visibility analysis in a SceneView. Visibility between a given observer and multiple target points is calculated against the currently displayed content in the view, including ground, integrated meshes and 3D objects such as buildings or trees.

name: mapapps-layer-swipe
description: The Swipe Layer bundle allows you to easily compare the content of two different layers in a map using the LayerSwipe widget to reveal the content of a layer on the map.

name: mapapps-labeling
description: This bundle labels features with border length and optional additional attributes.

name: mapapps-intro
description: This bundle allows you to create your own step-by-step guide in map.apps based on the Driver.js framework.

name: mapapps-highlight-config
description: The Highlight Config bundle adds the possibility to set highlightOptions via configuration.

name: mapapps-hierarchicalsearch
description: The Hierarchical Search Bundle offers a widget for searching features via a drop-down menu based on attributed values. The menus will be filled automaticaly based on the attribute ID and the previous user selections.

name: mapapps-elevation-profile
description: This bundle enables the ElevationProfile Widget from Esri in map.apps. It allows a user to input a polyline and calculates an elevation profile along this line.

name: mapapps-editing-usernameprocessor
description: This bundle registers an EditorInterceptor that provides the current username to the editing bundle.

name: mapapps-daylight
description: This bundle enables the user to display the effect of light of certain time of day. Additionally, the shadow of 3D-Objects can be simulated.

name: mapapps-coordinate-search
description: The Coordinate Search bundle adds the functionality to search for coordinates in multiple reference systems.

name: mapapps-conditional-renderer
description: The Conditional Renderer Bundle makes it possible to create mutliple renderers and feature reductions for a layer to be used in different scale ranges, all by configuration.

name: mapapps-clusterfeaturelayer
description: The ClusterFeatureLayer Bundle allows you to cluster features for any point feature service.

name: mapapps-charting
description: The Charting Bundle allows you to display various charts based on data from an AGSSearch store.

name: mapapps-building-explorer
description: The BuildingExplorer is used to filter and explore the various components of BuildingSceneLayers

name: mapapps-batchupdate
description: This bundle offers an additional Result-UI action to edit items in bulk.

name: mapapps-basemap-fader
description: This bundle provides a widget to fade from one baselayer to another baselayer.

name: mapapps-typescript-sample
description: Example project for TypeScript development in map.apps

name: mapapps-custom-nls
description: This bundle allows to customize the default nls strings that are used in map.apps (e.g. for tool titles or other ui elements)
